+# Persistent HTTP KV service
+
+Dependency-free Python 3.11+ key-value service with atomic JSON persistence and optional entry TTLs.
+
+## Run
+
+```sh
+python3 server.py --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080 --data ./data.json
+```
+
+Use `--port 0` to choose an available port. The first stdout line is `LISTENING <port>`; diagnostics are written to stderr.
+
+## API
+
+```sh
+curl -X PUT http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/kv/hello \
+  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"value":{"message":"world"},"ttl_seconds":60}'
+curl http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/kv/hello
+curl http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/keys
+curl -X DELETE http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/kv/hello
+curl http://127.0.0.1:8080/health
+```
+
+Keys are URL-encoded UTF-8 path components and cannot contain `/`. Every non-empty response body is JSON, including errors. Live state is written atomically to the configured data file after mutations and reloaded on restart.
+
+## Test
+
+```sh
+python3 -m unittest discover -v
+```

+        self.tempdir.cleanup()

+            ["python3", "server.py", "--host", "127.0.0.1", "--port", "0", "--data", str(self.data_path)],
+            cwd=ROOT, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True,
+        )
+        line = self.process.stdout.readline().strip()
+        self.assertRegex(line, r"^LISTENING [1-9][0-9]*$")
+        self.base_url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{line.split()[1]}"
+
